Take the record from the operation's successful JSON response and build the `custom_fields` object. Build the object only when the row contains `customFields`: a missing or null `customFields` leaves `custom_fields` out of the result (the `__c` properties are then not used). Use the `customFields` array when the row has one, otherwise the `custom_fields` array; turn each `{key, value, type}` entry into `key: value` (when a key appears more than once, the last entry wins). Then convert `long` and `number` values to numbers, convert `boolean` values to true or false, and leave other types unchanged; null values stay null. If the row has neither array, collect every property whose name ends in `__c` into the object; an empty array gives `{}` and the `__c` properties are then not used. Include `custom_fields` only when it was requested.
